preregistered: 2026-11-01 before implementation or evaluation of the local memory-panel source-impedance adapter
source_pages: CS-80 service BA27/BA28, MBK63 (image marked MKB), T51-T54 S31-S38; alternative pot/diode/driver values in docs/PRESET_BA_CUTOFF_BRANCHES.md and docs/workstreams/ws6-library.md
rationale: A local Thevenin source is a differential one-port tangent about the loaded DC operating point: the 10k assembled bus shunt stays inside the source, the receiver conductance is de-embedded, and unbuffered wiper currents can back-react through the shared 2SC458 selected rail. This is a diagonal reduction of a multiport nonlinear network, not a hardware-measured or global nonlinear open-circuit equivalent. The pre-existing 2mV DC model-consistency gate is retained without relaxation.

memory_panel_thevenin_v1.covered_positions: both ranks, source selectors 11/12/13, 24 analogue outputs, 0.1..0.9 wiper fractions; switch outputs 4/5 are logic only
memory_panel_thevenin_v1.mutation_contract: Omitting assembled 10k shunt, omitting receiver de-embedding, and zeroing shared-rail backreaction must each be independently detected
